CustomLevel.title: CustomLevel
CustomLevel.description: User-created Spot the Difference level that can be saved privately or shared with friends.

authorName.description: Display name of the level creator.

title.description: Title of the custom Spot the Difference level.

scenePrompt.description: Prompt describing the visual scene for AI generation.

variationCount.description: Number of subtle differences to spot (3 to 10).

patternComplexity.description: Complexity of the visual patterns and difference subtlety.

visibility.description: Whether the level is private to the creator or shared with friends/community.

shareCode.description: Short alphanumeric code to share the level with friends.

spotsData.description: Encoded difference hotspot coordinates, types, and descriptions.

playsCount.description: Number of times this custom level has been played.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Fastest completion time record for a Spot the Difference level, including the player's selected or AI-generated avatar.

playerAvatarData.description: Preset avatar ID (e.g. preset:cyber_detective) or compact base64 data URI of an AI-generated avatar.

boardId.description: Leaderboard scope (GLOBAL for public leaderboards, PRIVATE for personal history).

variationCount.description: Number of differences spotted in the level (3 to 10).

patternComplexity.description: Pattern complexity of the completed level.

completionTimeMillis.description: Time taken to spot all differences in milliseconds.

score.description: Calculated score based on speed, accuracy, variations, and complexity.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Player profile storing display name and selected or AI-generated custom avatar.

userId.description: Authenticated player UID (must match request.auth.uid and document ID).

avatarData.description: Preset avatar ID or compact base64 data URI of an AI-generated avatar.

avatarPrompt.description: Prompt used to generate the custom AI avatar, if any.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

/custom_levels/{levelId}.description: Stores custom Spot the Difference levels created by users.

/leaderboard_entries/{entryId}.description: Stores fastest completion times, scores, and player avatars for the global leaderboard.

/user_profiles/{userId}.description: Stores user profile display name and selected or AI-generated custom avatar.
